Laura Hietaranta (born 2 February 2004) is a Finnish tennis player. On the ITF Junior Circuit , Hietaranta has reached a career-high junior ranking of 32, achieved on 1 March 2021. Hietaranta has represented Finland in the Billie Jean King Cup , making her debut in 2020 . [ 1 ] Her win-loss record is 18–5, as of June 2025.
